items.title: Billy Bauer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: the only one I knew, Davy Tough, joined the band with me at the same time

ctx.x: I love it. Tell me about how Woody Herman came about.

Well Woody was, I think that’s in my book, I mean really how I got in with Woody you mean? Well I think Flip must have recommended me. Because he’s the only one that I knew when I joined them. But Woody rang up. And he says, “This is Woody.” I says, “Woody who?” I loved it. You know I wasn’t, I don’t know. So he says, “We’re over in The Meadowbrook,” and he says, “we’re leaving tomorrow.” He says, “Why don’t you come over and sit in with us one set?” So I says, “Gee I can’t do that tonight, Woody.” He says,…
I think Flip said he played with the Cliquot Eskimo — what is that?
